study.question: Can eliminating unconsumed residual-adapter evaluations reveal a useful quality-cost reduction, and can residual width12 preserve click AUC after the unsuccessful width8 reduction, under the unchanged joint model protocol?
study.hypothesis: Source observation: inside each of four task iterations, the incumbent computes four residual adapters and reads only the indexed output. The constructor enforces task routing, and each adapter contains only Linear/ReLU/Linear, so twelve of sixteen adapter evaluations have no output consumers or stateful effects. Indexed execution should preserve the mathematical function, all four-task loss gradients and learned capacity while reducing measured prediction cost. Separately, moderate width16-to12 reduction may remove marginal residual capacity without exceeding the prospectively fixed click-AUC loss allowance. This is unverified: historical width8 lost0.0002170676933398 AUC and did not improve prediction cost; its apparent closeness is not preservation evidence. Removing dead execution and narrowing capacity may interact in measured hardware cost, so both factors must be crossed. Trajectory review: baseline-din click AUC0.6555440824200336 remains the utility reference. Against incumbent0.666753547526167, round24 embedding12/scorer-half/both achieved0.6641111848808231/0.6654368615912554/0.6657555717414054; round25 tower-half/residual-half/both achieved0.6654569217074457/0.6665364798328272/0.6652781389154615. None demonstrated preserved click quality plus lower prediction latency under this proposal's new stricter criterion. Negative reductions are retained as evidence, not execution failures. These supplied controls reuse the same seed and are not independent mechanism replications.

nearest_work.difference: Exact inherited joint architecture; change only residual execution and optionally residual width. The unused bank outputs are an observed implementation limitation, not a literature originality claim.

Width8 reduced dense parameters from336549 to302117 but click AUC fell from0.666753547526167 to0.6665364798328272 and p50 latency was23.5462ms versus23.4362ms for its contemporaneous reference. Width12 is a new, moderate reduction, crossed with a function-preserving execution control.

study.proposed_difference: Run a2x2 factorial: residual width16 versus12, crossed with full-bank execution versus indexed execution. Reference16/bank is byte-identical to the frozen incumbent. Width12/bank changes only literal CONFIG and its matching constructor default. Indexed sources replace the four-adapter stack followed by index selection with residual_bank[index](residual_features); no modules, inputs or task routes are added. Use the full16/indexed cell as a parameter-matched replacement control for execution cost, and compare width12/indexed to it to attribute any capacity effect. This is an implementation optimization plus capacity study, not evidence for a new unified modeling mechanism.
predictions: At either width, same-state bank and indexed execution should yield identical predictions mathematically and equivalent joint-loss gradients, optimizer updates, initialization and Dice buffers. Adapter calls fall16-to4 per four-task forward; this predicts less residual work, not a75% whole-model speedup.

Width12 analytically has319333 dense and32112549 total parameters, with31793216 embedding parameters unchanged. Width16 has336549 dense and32129765 total. Host must measure; removal is17216 parameters (5.115% dense, approximately0.054% total), not a25% whole-model size reduction.

Prospective preservation rule for NEW width12 runs: full-population validation click AUC >=0.666553547526167 and paired delta versus fresh width16 reference >=-0.0002. This margin is chosen after seeing older width8 results and cannot validate that older trial retrospectively. Single-seed compliance remains preliminary.

Separate stricter execution-parity screen: within each fixed-width bank/indexed pair, absolute click-AUC difference <=0.000001 after the frozen training recipe; larger drift requires diagnosis even if the broad preservation margin passes.

Prospective cost utility screen: at batch8192 on the same host/device and scoring path, indexed candidate p50 model batch latency <=95% of contemporaneous bank16 reference with p95 <=100%; report inference wall seconds, examples/second, training seconds, full wall seconds, memory and parameter counts separately. Less than5% p50 saving is inconclusive utility under this screen, even if adapter-call reduction is exact.

All four task AUC/Logloss and the inherited history-length slice counts/AUC are reported. Existing joint-best auxiliary AUC is below DIN; preserving click does not establish auxiliary-task parity or production validity.

Host parity prerequisites before scientific interpretation: copy identical state_dict at each width and check train/eval outputs for all four labels, joint-loss parameter and input gradients, zero-versus-None gradients, all normalization buffers and one frozen-optimizer step on nonempty, empty, partial and noncontiguous histories. FP32 target tolerances: probability atol1e-7/rtol1e-6; gradients atol1e-6/rtol1e-5; buffers identical. BF16 same-state output target is exact equality because selected Linear shapes/inputs are unchanged; unexpected differences must be recorded and explained rather than silently loosening tolerances. Preserve label ordering, future/current-label exclusion and existing auxiliary item/scorer gradient gates. Host diagnostics are required and charged; no tensor results have been obtained locally.
falsifiers: Any same-state fixed-width output, buffer, joint-gradient or frozen-optimizer-step discrepancy beyond host numerical tolerances rejects the exact-execution-equivalence implementation until diagnosed; no source-level proof substitutes for actual BF16 execution.

A width12 AUC loss >0.0002 against either frozen incumbent or fresh paired reference rejects its preservation utility at that seed. A paired user-cluster bootstrap interval crossing the margin leaves preservation unresolved, not established.

No measured latency saving, p95 regression, or saving that vanishes under charged repeated timings rejects the indexed utility claim at this host batch size; launch overhead and history/scorer work may dominate.

If width16/indexed yields the same improvement as width12/indexed, attribute the measured saving to execution specialization; do not credit capacity reduction without the within-indexed width contrast.

If the byte-identical reference fails to reproduce frozen AUC within0.000001 or has execution/masking errors, suspend candidate selection and investigate the bridge without changing the protocol or hiding charged failures.
alternative_explanations: GPU load, warmup, measurement order, data-loading noise or synchronization differences can explain timing changes; use the unchanged host measurement path and contemporaneous bridge
Narrower residuals alter random initialization and nonlinear fit, so width effects are not a mechanistic proof of irrelevant dimensions
Different autograd accumulation order or zero-versus-None gradients can affect the frozen AdamW trajectory even when forward algebra agrees
A single frozen seed and repeated exposures from the same user cannot establish population noninferiority; use authorized paired user-cluster intervals and later paired seeds when available

Earlier embedding/scorer and tower reductions lost AUC; they neither refute all capacity removal nor support this execution optimization. No local failed execution is in the supplied history; these were successful executions with negative utility evidence
